name: smwsprites-boomerang-bro
title: Boomerang Bro
description:
A Boomerang Bro from Super Mario Bros. 3. It walks back and forth, occasionally hopping and periodically throwing two boomerangs, which it will later try to catch.

It throws an extended sprite boomerang. The included ExtendedGetDrawInfo fixes a crash in PIXI's, so it is highly recommended you replace it with it.

Make sure to specify the extended sprite number of the boomerang (extended/boomerang.asm) from list.txt in the Boomerang Bro's ASM file (sprites/BoomerangBro.asm)!

Mod edit 2025-2-9: Fixed a typo in the boomerang tilemap resulting in some garbled graphics, reported by Atari2.0
